notes: Shopify store, reached by DIRECT fetch, no proxy needed (as in the prior Home-Decor pass). Category tree taken from the site's own server-rendered Furniture mega-menu in the homepage HTML (Living Room / Bedroom / Dining Room columns) and cross-checked against sitemap.xml -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (529 collections) scanned for furniture slugs. QTY METHOD: the rendered listing header 'See N results' on each collection page, then INDEPENDENTLY re-derived by exhausting /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 and counting unique product ids. The two methods agreed EXACTLY on all 19 collections tested, and the number differs per collection (1..59), so it is a real per-category total, not a site-wide constant. Each page's h1 was checked to confirm the right listing loaded. HIERARCHY PROOF: the Furniture parent collection (59) is exactly the union of the 13 menu leaf collections (58 unique ids) plus one item, 'Sylvie Desk in Fern' - so Furniture is a pure roll-up and is emitted as a grouping structure only, and the missing desk is covered by the off-menu 'Desks & Game Tables' collection (2), which is included with a flag. EXCLUDED - 'Shop All Living Room' (all-living-room-furniture, 31), 'Shop All Bedroom' (all-bedroom-furniture, 13), 'Shop All Dining Room' (dining-room-furniture, 15) and the Furniture landing page (59) as shop-all/parent pages per the brief; note /collections/living-room-furniture is an alias of all-living-room-furniture (same h1, same 31). 'Upholstery Swatches' (16) sits in the Furniture menu but its products are fabric swatches ('Fenton Flannel Fabric Swatch', 'Blue Velvet Fabric Swatch', ...), i.e. textiles/parts, not furniture. 'Sale Furniture' (51) dropped as a Sale page. Off-menu legacy collections found in the sitemap and tested: 'Office Furniture' (7) = 'Office Chairs' (5) + 'Desks & Game Tables' (2); Office Chairs is a 5/5 subset of Accent Chairs (Genevieve, St. James, Faye, Mandarin, Adele) so it was dropped as a re-cut, as were 'Swivel Chairs' (1, inside Accent Chairs), 'Collected Furniture' (2), 'Collected Seating' (1). Empty collections omitted rather than recorded as zero rows: Shelves & Cabinets (0), Garden Stools (0), Shop All Outdoor Furniture (0), Collected Tables (0), Collected Seating (0) - so this brand currently sells no outdoor furniture and no shelving/cabinets. Cait Kids 'Furniture' (3: Coco Children's Rocking Chair, The Penn Bed, The Olivia Bed) was ID-checked against the 12 adult furniture leaves and is genuinely distinct inventory (0 overlap), so unlike the prior pass's kids decor/lighting it is kept as a real leaf.
